title: Re: MayaValley SpaceX – pre-IPO opportunity (confidential)
description:
Dear MayaValley Investors,


We have secured a new SpaceX allocation through a counterparty we have
higher confidence in. The entry valuation is approximately *$1.43T -
implying ~22% upside to the $1.75T IPO target and ~40% upside to the $2T
valuation - with dramatically better fee terms: 8% upfront vs 15%
originally, and 7% carry vs 12%.* More capital is deployed from day one,
and we get to keep more of the profit at exit.



For context, the group we had a verbal commitment from last week was
ultimately unable to honor their original economics. There is significant
demand right now and the market is moving fast; they came back with higher
fees and a much smaller allocation than originally discussed, after their
selling LP decided to reduce how much they were divesting. We decided not
to proceed with them on those terms.



*Terms comparison*



*Original*

*New*

Entry Valuation

~$1.43T

Management Fee

15%

8%

Carry

12%

7%

Deployed per $100

$85

Very likely, we will receive in-kind proceeds (shares) once the lock-up
expires.
